name: Sparse Voxel DAG
aliases: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for voxel encoding
Directed Acyclic Graph for voxel encoding
definition: An extension to SVO that merges identical nodes and redirects parent pointers to single nodes to decrease memory footprint further.
summary: Sparse Voxel DAG compresses sparse voxel octrees by merging identical nodes into a directed acyclic graph, reducing memory footprint compared to standard octrees.
